annotations.title: Add or update a campaign step

description: Add or update one step of a campaign sequence: an email step (type email, the default) or a LinkedIn step. Email: subject and body_text (or body_html); update by step_id, or by order (the email's number) when that email exists. LinkedIn: type linkedin_view (opens the lead's profile), linkedin_like (likes their latest post), linkedin_invite (connection request, optional note up to 300 characters) or linkedin_message (message_text to a connection). A new LinkedIn step goes at position in the whole sequence (emails and LinkedIn steps together; omit position to append); change or remove one (remove=true) by the step_id the result's sequence lists. delay_days is the wait after a step before the next one; after a linkedin_invite followed by linkedin_message steps it is how long to wait for acceptance: the messages go to people who accepted, the others continue with the step after the messages. The first LinkedIn step needs warm_reply_text (the warm branch: the reply sent in the lead's email thread after a positive answer); warm_invite also sends them a connection request, notify_url (Slack or Telegram webhook, or the user's HTTPS endpoint) tells the user; type warm_branch changes only these. LinkedIn steps need a LinkedIn account connected in the app (it acts for the mailbox it is linked to) and a linkedin_url column in the imported contacts. The campaign must be a draft.

delay_days.description: Wait after this step before the next one (LinkedIn steps: at most 90).

notify_telegram_chat_id.description: Telegram notify_url: the chat id (required for Telegram).

notify_telegram_topic_id.description: Telegram notify_url: optional forum topic id.

notify_url.description: Warm branch: HTTPS URL told about each positive answer (Slack incoming webhook, Telegram bot sendMessage URL, or the user's endpoint). Empty string removes it.

position.description: LinkedIn steps: place in the whole sequence (1 = first); later steps move down. Omit to append.

remove.description: With a LinkedIn step_id: remove that step.

step_id.description: Step to update: an email step id, or a LinkedIn step id (linkedin-N) from the result's sequence.

type.description: email, a LinkedIn step (linkedin_view, linkedin_like, linkedin_invite, linkedin_message), or warm_branch to change only the warm branch.

warm_invite.description: Warm branch: also send a LinkedIn connection request after a positive answer.

warm_invite_note.description: Warm branch: note of that connection request.

warm_reply_subject.description: Warm branch: subject of that reply (empty: reply in the same thread).

warm_reply_text.description: Warm branch: the reply sent in the lead's email thread after a positive answer. Required once per campaign with LinkedIn steps.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Optional: defaults to the workspace picked at sign-in or bound to the API key.

name: upsert_campaign_step

linkedin_accounts.description: Connected LinkedIn accounts of the workspace.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one sentence.

not_in_sequence.description: Email orders the sequence does not send.

position.description: LinkedIn steps: place of this step in the sequence.

sequence.description: LinkedIn steps: the whole sequence in order, emails and LinkedIn steps.

warm_branch.description: LinkedIn steps: reply, invite and notification after a positive answer.
